results.title: 91% of studies in India in last 5 decades linked air pollution to health effects: Analysis

results.title: President Droupadi Murmu, PM Modi pay tribute to Birsa Munda at Delhi’s Parliament complex
results.content: On the occasion of Jharkhand’s State Foundation Day and the 151st birth anniversary of tribal leader Birsa Munda, President Droupadi Murmu and Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Sunday paid floral tributes to the tribal icon, known as ‘Dharti Aaba’, at the Parliament complex in New Delhi. Also present were Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan, Union Law Minister Arjun Ram Meghwal and Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla.
